design_condition: The volumes are concentrated on one side of the plot to create generous open space, respond to neighbouring scale, and structure varied outdoor areas, although the tallest volume weakens the ensemble’s integration.

positive.statement: The three-building arrangement integrates the complex carefully into the district and creates differentiated outdoor spaces.
The facility is clearly organized and offers good orientation through multiple entrances and a consistent spatial structure.
The vine-covered cafeteria terrace promises to become an identity-creating place for the complex and the district.
The revised open-space arrangement convincingly extends the green corridor and connects to the wider neighbourhood structure.
The revised structural concept reduces the proportion of CO2-intensive building materials.
The economic indicators suggest that the target costs will be adhered to.

negative.statement: The high point obscures the otherwise obvious interaction of the three buildings.
The dead-straight avenues seem strange within the organically developed landscape.
Existing routes and new connecting axes unnecessarily double the circulation network.
The delivery route through the playground is unacceptable, and the open underground-car-park entrance is incomprehensible.
The sports entrances facing away from the street are difficult for external visitors to find.
Many classrooms receive insufficient daylight because of minimal floor heights and low window lintels.
The primary school’s main stairs are extremely awkward and create spatial-structural conflicts.
A more spacious internal connection to the sports area is desirable instead of minimal corridors.
The photovoltaic provision remains far from achieving the desired solar-power contribution.
The hybrid structural system remains puzzling, particularly around the sports halls.
The revised break area does not yet fulfil its role as an arrival and retreat space.
The hesitantly approached photovoltaic strategy and proposed facade material require further checking.
